title: Semiotic Artifact Contract
description: A portable interpretation sidecar that keeps an information artifact's purpose, claims, evidence, time, reception, accountability, and preservation requirements inspectable across interfaces.

artifact.description: Stable identity and content fingerprints for the artifact.

purpose.description: Declared purpose, intended decisions, stakes, and use boundaries.

claims.description: Claims the artifact communicates or relies on.

evidence.description: Evidence records referenced by claims and transformations.

time.description: Event, processing, publication, freshness, window, and revision clocks.

reception.description: Audience and channel requirements for receiving the artifact.

form.description: Reasoning, risks, and alternatives associated with the chosen form.

contestability.description: Ways to challenge, correct, or inspect alternative views of the artifact.

accountability.description: Authorship, review, source, and downstream-action records.

inheritance.description: Requirements that must survive copying, export, or handoff.

fieldStatus.description: Path-keyed knowledge states for obligations that are unknown, manual, or not applicable.

extensions.description: Explicit namespaced extension data preserved without changing core semantics.

jsonObject.description: An explicitly open object whose values are JSON-safe.

status.description: Whether this field is known, unresolved, manually judged, or outside the artifact's scope.

reason.description: Explanation for the field's knowledge state.

suppliedBy.description: Actor class responsible for the recorded state.

derived.description: Whether the state came from deterministic derivation.

reviewedBy.description: Identifier for the reviewer who resolved or confirmed the state.

component.description: Rendering component when the artifact is a chart.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp supplied by the producing system or author.

configFingerprint.description: Deterministic identity of the serializable configuration.

dataFingerprint.description: Deterministic identity of the bound data and declared transformations without embedding the data itself.

id.description: Intent identifier from an open vocabulary.

source.description: How the intent entered the contract.

communicativeAct.description: What the artifact asks its audience to understand or do.

decisionContext.description: Decision or workflow in which the artifact will be used.

stakes.description: Consequence level of acting on the artifact.

allowedUses.description: Uses the author or policy explicitly permits.

prohibitedUses.description: Uses the author or policy explicitly prohibits.

kind.description: Actor category from an open vocabulary.

status.description: Editorial review state for a claim.

reviewer.description: Actor responsible for the review decision.

reviewedAt.description: Timestamp recorded by the review system.

kind.description: Form in which uncertainty is represented.

confidence.description: Confidence measure using the producer's stated scale.

description.description: Qualitative explanation of uncertainty and limitations.

id.description: Stable identifier referenced by evidence, corrections, and actions.

kind.description: Evidence and communication category of the claim.

status.description: Current support and publication state of the claim.

evidenceIds.description: Identifiers of evidence records supporting or qualifying the claim.

scope.description: Structured bounds on population, filters, geography, or other applicability.

asOf.description: Time at which the claim should be interpreted.

supersedes.description: Earlier claim identifiers replaced by this claim.

authoredBy.description: Actor responsible for authoring the claim.

review.description: Editorial review record for the claim.

tags.description: Open labels used for discovery or policy selection.

retrievedAt.description: Timestamp at which the source was retrieved.

publisher.description: Organization or actor publishing the source.

kind.description: Class of transformation applied to evidence.

inputEvidenceIds.description: Evidence identifiers consumed by the transformation.

implementation.description: Code, query, or procedure implementing the transformation.

performedAt.description: Timestamp at which the transformation was performed.

performedBy.description: Actor or system that performed the transformation.

fields.description: Fields included in the bounded sample.

truncated.description: Whether values omit part of the available sample.

id.description: Stable evidence identifier referenced by claims and transformations.

role.description: Role the evidence plays in supporting or qualifying claims.

source.description: Origin and retrieval metadata for the evidence.

fingerprint.description: Deterministic content identity for the evidence.

observedAt.description: Timestamp represented by the evidence observation.

scope.description: Structured bounds on the evidence's applicability.

sample.description: Bounded sample retained for inspection without requiring full raw data.

transformation.description: Transformation record when this evidence was produced from other evidence.

generatedClaimId.description: Claim identifier generated from this evidence, when applicable.

relationship.description: Strength and interpretation of the evidence-to-claim relationship.

field.description: Name of the field carrying event time.

value.description: Event-time value represented by the artifact.

timezone.description: Timezone used to interpret the event-time value.

granularity.description: Resolution at which event time is meaningful.

id.description: Stable identifier for a temporal source or processing stage.

kind.description: Kind of source or processing stage.

observedAt.description: Most recent observation timestamp for this source.

version.description: Version reported by this source or processing stage.

granularity.description: Temporal resolution supplied by this source.

freshness.description: Freshness state reported for this source.

completeness.description: Completeness state reported for this source.

state.description: How the interface presents the artifact's temporal state.

heartbeatAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent source heartbeat.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp after which the artifact should be considered stale.

basis.description: Rule or observation used to determine freshness.

value.description: Latest event time known to be included under the stated policy.

allowedLateness.description: Accepted lateness interval beyond the watermark.

start.description: Inclusive start of the represented temporal window.

end.description: End of the represented temporal window.

status.description: Settlement or revision state of the represented window.
Completeness state of the represented data.

basis.description: Rule or observation used to determine completeness.

status.description: Revision relationship to previously published data or artifacts.

previousArtifactId.description: Identifier of the earlier artifact affected by this revision.

correctionId.description: Identifier of the correction record governing this revision.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version associated with the snapshot.

catalogRef.description: Catalog reference used to locate the snapshot.

eventTime.description: Field and value used as event time.

observedAt.description: Timestamp at which the represented event or condition was observed.

ingestedAt.description: Timestamp at which data entered the processing system.

publishedAt.description: Timestamp at which the artifact was published.

snapshotAt.description: Timestamp represented by a static snapshot.

presentation.description: How temporal state is communicated to the audience.

window.description: Time window summarized by the artifact.

completeness.description: Completeness evaluation for the represented data.

revision.description: Revision state relative to earlier artifacts or data.

snapshot.description: Storage snapshot that can reproduce the represented state.

channel.description: Interface channel governed by these reception requirements.

disclosure.description: Level of supporting context the channel should disclose.

navigation.description: Whether the channel must provide navigable structure.

interactionInstructions.description: Whether the channel must explain available interactions.

rawData.description: Raw-data access allowed through this channel.

tokenBudget.description: Approximate total serialized grounding-payload budget for this channel, using four characters per token and a 256-token minimum for identity, safety, and omission metadata.

privacyNotes.description: Privacy constraints or disclosures for the channel.

channels.description: Requirements for each supported reception channel.

strengths.description: Ways this artifact supports audience understanding.

risks.description: Audience-specific risks of misunderstanding or misuse.

scaffolds.description: Explanations or aids required for interpretation.

description.description: Accessible prose description of the artifact.

dataFallback.description: Whether a structured data fallback is required.

manualChecks.description: Reception checks that require human judgment.

reason.description: Reason the alternative was not selected.

chartFamily.description: Chart or presentation family chosen for the artifact.

whyThisForm.description: Reason the selected form fits the purpose and evidence.

risks.description: Interpretive risks introduced by the chosen form.

misuse.description: Foreseeable misuses of the chosen form.

status.description: Current handling state of the challenge.

reason.description: Substantive reason for raising the challenge.

raisedAt.description: Timestamp at which the challenge was raised.

counterclaimId.description: Claim identifier offering an alternative interpretation.

affectedClaimIds.description: Claim identifiers affected by the correction.

createdAt.description: Timestamp at which the correction was recorded.

rationale.description: Reason this alternative view is useful.

ruleId.description: Identifier of the rule receiving an exception.

owner.description: Actor or team accountable for the exception.

reviewAt.description: Timestamp at which the exception should be reviewed.

sourceRequestsAllowed.description: Whether recipients may request underlying sources.

corrections.description: Corrections issued for claims in this artifact lineage.

editorialExceptions.description: Documented exceptions to editorial or policy rules.

reviewer.description: Actor responsible for the review decision.

reviewedAt.description: Timestamp at which the review decision was recorded.

policyId.description: Policy identifier under which the review occurred.

action.description: Action proposed or taken in response to the artifact.

actedAt.description: Timestamp at which the action was recorded.

claimIds.description: Claims on which the action depended.

artifactId.description: Artifact identifier consulted for the action when the surrounding collection is ambiguous.

artifactRevision.description: Artifact revision consulted for the action.

invalidatedByClaimId.description: Claim identifier that invalidated the action.

authors.description: Actors responsible for authoring the artifact.

generatedBy.description: Tool or process that generated the artifact.

dataSources.description: Source identifiers used by the artifact.

codeRef.description: Code, build, or deployment reference for reproducing the artifact.

reviews.description: Recorded review decisions for the artifact.

actions.description: Downstream actions tied to specific claims and revisions.

requiredPaths.description: Contract paths that must be retained in derived artifacts.

prohibitedExports.description: Export formats or destinations that are not allowed.

privacy.description: Privacy classification that must survive handoff.

rawDataDefault.description: Default raw-data handling for derived outputs.

preservation.description: Semantic preservation class for export or transformation.

sourceArtifactIds.description: Source artifact identifiers from which this artifact inherits obligations.
